args.message: I can't give a daily breakdown from monthly_rev. That model only holds one revenue total per month (it groups orders by month and sums the amount), so the daily detail isn't in it. When I asked it for daily figures, SLayer refused: data already grouped by month can't be split back into days. The daily figures for January 2025 would have to come from the underlying orders model instead, by summing the order amounts per day of order_date.
